audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Cassiopeia all seven rows while content and the packet chart give Kassadin rows 4-6.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and grounds Riftwalk only for its duration; once Kassadin has R plus first item he enters on that cooldown and Cassiopeia has no dash to leave. The full-layer whys for rows 4-6 already describe Kassadin winning, so the side fields were simply stale.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side set to Kassadin, matching content win[4..6] which already read Kassadin.

audit.why: Spikes correctly place her at 3-5 and Kassadin at 6, first item and full build.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number and omitted both Petrifying Gaze's facing requirement and Twin Fang's healing.
audit.why: Miasma 24/22/20/18/16s grounds Movement abilities, which is what turns Riftwalk off; Petrifying Gaze (120/100/80s) stuns only enemies facing her and slows those turned away; Twin Fang is a 0.75s cooldown that heals a percentage of damage dealt, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades; Noxious Blast is a flat 3.5s and is effectively always up.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with real numbers; anti-heal folded into itemization.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said only 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' — wrong pronoun and no item named.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals off every poison tick, so the anti-heal item needs naming.

edits.before: Eat the magic with the shield and serve the late game he can't cancel. Shorthand: Miasma down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Eat the poison with the shield and serve the late game she can't cancel. Shorthand: Miasma down, wave right, go.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Q-shield her Twin Fang chunk, W refund the auto, walk out of the poison — post-6 add a blink and you finally win one.

edits.before: Survive. The shield eats one spell per trade — make it his important one and concede the rest.
edits.after: Survive. The shield eats one spell per trade — make it her Twin Fang and concede the poison ticks.

edits.before: Best wave: a centered wave you farm with refunds — your whole laning phase is a parking job; park it well. Worst wave: a shoved wave at his tower pre-6 — the weakest early champion in mid, two screens from help, on purpose, apparently. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: a centered wave you farm with refunds — your whole laning phase is a parking job; park it well. Worst wave: a shoved wave at her tower pre-6 — you stand in Miasma with no dash out, two screens from help, which is how Petrify finds you. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win. Bad trade: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Good trade: Q-shield her Twin Fang chunk, W refund the auto, walk out of the poison — post-6 add a blink and you finally win one. Bad trade: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Nether Blade's 7s cooldown refunds mana on every empowered last hit — that is how you afford the Q shield against a 3.5s Noxious Blast.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Before two items, forcing into Miasma means grounded, no Riftwalk out, and Twin Fang healing her through your burst.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Riftwalk like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5, and it grounds Riftwalk for its whole duration — step in only once it is spent. - Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1 and stuns only enemies facing her. - Noxious Blast is a flat 3.5s; it is never down.

edits.before: Cassiopeia wins by landing Miasma, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Cassiopeia wins by grounding you with Miasma so Riftwalk is dead, then healing through the trade with Twin Fang.

edits.before: Carry through inevitability — no champion converts time into power like Kassadin; your job is making the clock run.
edits.after: Carry by outliving the poison: your passive cuts her magic damage, and entering from outside Miasma is the whole game.

edits.before: Ahead, accelerate the clock: blink-trade Cassiopeia's every gap, follow each roam instantly, and reach three items before the map adjusts.
edits.after: Ahead, deny her tempo: blink onto Cassiopeia whenever Miasma is on its 24s cooldown, and reach three items before the map adjusts.

edits.before: Eat the magic with the shield and serve the late game he can't cancel. Shorthand: Miasma down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Eat the poison with the shield and serve the late game she can't cancel. Shorthand: Miasma down, wave right, go.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Rod of Ages into Seraph's, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's and Rabadon's — mana is stacks is power. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Rod of Ages into Seraph's, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's and Rabadon's — mana is stacks is power. Morellonomicon early — Twin Fang heals her every tick.
